# AtherosAI Developer Compliance Kit

> Produced by the AI Product Factory (`product-factory` orchestrator), phases 0–8, mode `enterprise`.
> Vendor: **AtherosAI B.V.** Sibling to — not a fork of — the AtherosAI Platform.

**Compliance evidence, generated by the system that needs it.**

An enterprise Python toolkit that runs inside a customer's codebase and CI and produces the
artefacts AI governance asks for — bias scores, PII-masking logs, EU AI Act classifications,
vendor assessments — automatically, hash-chained, and without their data leaving the process.

## Two things to run

```bash
# The product
cd atheros-compliance-kit
python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]'
.venv/bin/pytest -q                     # 102 passed, no network, no API key
.venv/bin/atheros-kit doctor

# The console
cd ../console && npm install && npm run web       # http://localhost:8081
```

## The four modules

| | Module | Answers |
|---|---|---|
| M1 | `atheros_kit.rag` | Is our knowledge base biased, duplicated, drifting, or full of PII? |
| M2 | `atheros_kit.guard` | What leaves for a third-party LLM, and what comes back? |
| M3 | `atheros_kit.euact` | What is our EU AI Act tier, defensibly — and what does Annex IV still need? |
| M4 | `atheros_kit.vendor` | Can this supplier be used, and is the training opt-out actually enforced? |
| | `atheros_kit.cicd` | Fail the build when any of the above regresses. |

## The design decision the whole product rests on

**Unmeasured is never a pass.** A score of `None` renders grey, fails the gate, and says so.
"No indicator matched" is never rendered as "low risk". Ambiguity produces a grey zone with the
conflict named, not a confident wrong answer. Every competitor's dashboard is all green; this one
tells you what it could not establish.

The full contract is in [`PLAYBOOK.md` §7](PLAYBOOK.md).

**It does not certify.** The Kit assesses and evidences — enforced by a CI lint over generated
artefacts, not by good intentions.
